full_prompt_en: A square oil painting depicts a lively gathering outside an old stone building, its earth brown walls set against a deep, leafy darkness. The upper part of the wall is mottled with warm ocher, gray, and soot colored patches, while the shadowed center opens into an almost black recess. At the left edge, a man in a dark hat and brown outer coat leans against the wall, his pale shirt catching a little light. Just behind him, a second pale shirt and softly painted face emerge from the dimness. Near the center, a young man in a reddish brimmed hat stands forward in a white open neck shirt, dark jacket, and tawny trousers. His legs form a relaxed, slightly uneven stance over the rough brown ground, and his left arm rests among the companions around him. Several other men crowd the shadow directly behind and to his right, their heads and shoulders overlapping so closely that individual outlines disappear into the dark mass. On the right, a figure in a muted red coat inclines toward the group, with dark trousers and a pale shirt opening visible beneath the coat. The faces are modeled with small touches of warm flesh color rather than hard lines, and the clothes are described through broad folds, broken highlights, and areas of nearly lost detail. Across the foreground, dull earth tones and loose scumbled marks suggest an uneven dusty surface. Soft light falls from the upper left, brightening the white shirts, the central face, and the ocher trousers while leaving the recess and clustered figures in deep brown shadow. Thin glints and rough strokes on the masonry interrupt the larger dark fields. The overall composition gathers its warm human accents inside a dense, shadowy setting, giving the scene a conversational, slightly theatrical warmth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画描绘一群人聚集在古旧石建筑外的热闹场面，土褐色墙面与深沉的枝叶暗影相接。墙面上部布满暖赭色、灰色和烟黑色的斑驳痕迹，中央阴影处则敞开一个近乎漆黑的凹入空间。左边缘，一名戴深色帽子、穿棕色外套的男子倚在墙边，浅色衬衫接住少许光。其后，另一件浅色衬衫和柔和刻画的面孔从暗处浮现。中央附近，一名戴红褐色宽檐帽的年轻男子站在前方，穿敞领白衬衫、深色外套和黄褐色长裤。他的双腿以轻松而略不对称的姿势立在粗糙的棕色地面上，左臂搭在周围同伴之间。另有几名男子拥挤在他身后和右侧的阴影里，头肩紧密重叠，个别轮廓融进深色整体。右侧一名穿暗红外套的人朝人群倾身，外套下露出深色长裤与浅色衬衫开口。面孔由少量暖肉色笔触塑造，而非硬线勾勒；衣服则以宽阔的褶皱、断续亮部和几乎隐没的细节表现。前景中，暗哑土色和松散擦抹的笔迹暗示起伏不平的尘土地面。柔和的光从左上方落下，照亮白衬衫、中央的面庞和赭黄长裤，凹入处及密集人群则留在深棕阴影中。石墙上的细碎亮痕与粗糙笔触打破了大片暗色。整体构图将温暖的人物亮色聚集在浓重的阴影环境里，赋予场面交谈般、略带戏剧感的暖意。
style_prompt_en: Oil paint forms a warm, low keyed range of ocher, umber, muted red, charcoal, and small chalky cream accents. Loose, layered brushwork and dry scumbled patches break the surface into irregular marks, while selected lighter passages are built with thicker, more opaque strokes. Contours remain soft and interrupted; neighboring dark shapes often merge before a brief pale edge separates them. The brightest warm notes gather near the visual center and stand against broad surrounding masses of deep brown, producing emphasis without a rigid outline. Light spreads gently across raised surfaces and falls quickly into recesses, so depth grows from overlapping value fields as much as from linear perspective. Rough texture remains visible even in shadow, with flecks of pigment and warmer underlayers flickering through darker paint. Asymmetrical clustering and a compressed depth keep the composition intimate and active. The overall effect is earthy, painterly, and quietly dramatic, with broken surfaces carrying the movement of the image.
style_prompt_zh: 油彩构成以赭黄、棕褐、暗红、炭黑为主的温暖低明度色域，少量粉白色形成重音。松散叠加的笔触和干擦色斑将表面分解为不规则痕迹，选定的浅色区域则以更厚、更不透明的笔触建立。轮廓柔和而断续；相邻的深色形体常先融为一体，再由短暂的浅色边缘分开。最明亮的暖色聚集在视觉中心附近，与四周大片深棕色块相对，无需坚硬勾线便形成重点。光轻柔地铺过凸起表面，并迅速衰减进凹处，因此空间深度既来自明度块面的重叠，也来自线性透视。阴影里仍可见粗糙肌理，颜料碎点和较暖的底层色在深色涂层间闪现。非对称的密集组织与压缩的纵深让构图显得亲近而活跃。整体效果质朴、富于绘画性且含蓄地富有戏剧感，破碎的色面承载了画面的动势。
theme_en: A lively group gathered outside a weathered stone building
theme_zh: 一群人聚集在斑驳石建筑外的热闹场面
name: David Wilkie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
